title.zh: 实施第4637号共和国法规定，在反挂名委员会中设立检察处的法案
title.en: An Act Implementing the Provisions of Republic Act Numbered Forty-Six Hundred Thirty-Seven, Creating a Prosecution Division in the Anti-Dummy Board
title.orig: An Act Implementing the Provisions of Republic Act Numbered Forty-Six Hundred Thirty-Seven, Creating a Prosecution Division in the Anti-Dummy Board

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1966/ra_4699_1966.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: To carry out the provisions of Republic Act Numbered Four thousand six hundred and thirty-seven, the amount of one hundred twenty-three thousand six hundred pesos is hereby appropriated, out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, during the fiscal year nineteen hundred sixty-six-nineteen hundred sixty-seven. Thereafter, said sum as provided for in this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 18, 1966.
